title: FDP Demo: Multi-center Imaging Study
objective: Evaluate federated training on anonymized imaging and EHR metadata across three hospitals to predict outcomes.
result_sharing: Aggregate metrics (AUC, loss curves) will be shared. No raw data will leave institutions.
responsibilities: Each site ensures proper pseudonymization, access logging, and timely updates.

title: Federated Genomics Association Study
objective: Assess genome-wide associations for cardiovascular risk using privacy-preserving FL across biobanks.
result_sharing: Only aggregated statistics and Manhattan plots will be shared.
responsibilities: Participating sites will control access, review audits, and maintain secure runtimes.

title: Wearable Sensor FL Benchmark
objective: Benchmark FL algorithms on wearable activity and vitals data for early anomaly detection.
result_sharing: Aggregated metrics and ablation summaries only.
responsibilities: Maintain device data pipelines and provide incident reporting within 72 hours.
